create_synthetic_data: create synthetic train and eval dataloaders with one-hot action labels for behavioral cloning
train_bc_model: train a behavioral cloning model using a fully connected DQN and PyTorch Lightning
eval_bc_model: evaluate a trained behavioral cloning model and compute average cross-entropy loss
get_dummy_batch: generate dummy behavioral cloning training batches with one-hot actions and state tensors
test_behavioral_cloning_v0: run the behavioral cloning unit test that trains and evaluates a BC model end to end
